notes.title: Clever Girls Demo - Update Version 1.1.3 and Future Plans
notes.content:
[h1]We've updated the Clever Girls Demo! [/h1][h2]This update focus on addressing crashes, bugfixes and major refinements. We're planning on releasing more updates too! See below for all the details on what we changed, and what we plan to change!

Note: [/h2][list][*][p]Old version save data should still be compatible with this build. Please report any remaining issues with saving and loading data on the Steam Community, or with the in-game bug report form link.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features:[/h2][list][*][p]Added a "Recent Dialogue" window to the pause menu, which shows the latest non-VN dialogue that has printed to the screen. Use this to read any in-battle or exploration mode dialogue that may have faded out too quickly. Currently, however, it only shows the single most recent dialogue event. This will likely be improved in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]When switching characters near obstacles, the player character is now adjusted to a nearby open area if there is any available. This won't fix every situation where switching from a smaller to larger character will get you stuck, but it should fix most. The full game will have "rescue points" set up to handle the situation where an appropriate adjustment cannot be found.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Unreal engine version from UE 5.3.2 to UE 5.6.1. This version is expected to have significantly faster rendering for some CPUs, and contains many engine-level bugfixes and performance enhancements. [b]We've tested the build, but if there's any new issues that we didn't catch, please report them.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes / Tweaks:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed issue where VN dialogue was automatically advancing without player input[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Poacher Radio Operators now turn to face the location where they think their most threatening target was when they use the radio. This makes the Ventriloquism ability more effective on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased interaction range for throwable objects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed GPU-related crash on startup for AMD RX500-series GPUs. (Let us know if it still has problems!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Make a certain sign in a certain level have higher contrast, to better show off a very good joke[/p][/*][*][p]VN events can no longer be advanced by player inputs while the log screen is visible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where autoplay would skip cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse sensitivity and some other option settings not applying upon level load[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple objectives not checking when completed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug whereupon opening the Options menu on the main screen might have caused the Play Story Demo button to instead start Quick Battle[/p][/*][*][p]Turboskip now requires a hold input (even when pressing the on-screen button)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the autoplay pause time before advancing. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where autoplay wouldn't advance after cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various crashes upon loading into some autosave points. Save data is expected to be intact still, so old saves that had this issue should now work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced foliage shimmering[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reduced foliage shadow noise greatly[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly increased the allotted reading time for many non-VN dialogues.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing individual scene viewings from being recorded, therefore preventing some conditional dialogue from playing. [/p][list][*][p]Affected scenes include: [/p][list][*][p]The broken mascot interaction. A variant of the VN will play if Daisy has seen the mascot before (If the mascot event is viewed after the update.)[/p][/*][*][p]The event where the perfect campsite is found. Sawyer now acknowledges that you've been to that campsite before if you stopped by earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]The security camera blocking cutscene. A shorter variation will play in subsequent encounters with security cameras.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed an FX layer off a Daisy expression that would often clip off the top of the screen. Daisy is tall![/p][/*][*][p]Various typo fixes. Made some Shade lines more in-character.[/p][/*][*][p]Various small level geometry optimizations	[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known issues (to be addressed in future updates):[/h2][list][*][p]Some save games have unintuitive location names. We're in the process of reworking the system that these names are derived from.[/p][/*][*][p]After Sawyer leaps into the scene during her tutorial introduction, she freezes completely still for the rest of the cutscene. This will be fixed in the next update! Probably. For now, just pretend she's petrified from stage fright.[/p][/*][*][p]In some cases the "spotted" visual effect will continually retrigger on subsequent turns, even on characters that are clearly hidden. This is only a visual issue and the hidden character is not actually being spotted. We're working on diagnosing this one. [/p][/*][*][p]Breakable barriers still can't be targeted directly with thrown objects, and can't be jumped over. This will require some reworking of how breakables work to fix cleanly, so it'll likely be fixed in next patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Shade's animation for diving into water snaps her in a strange way. Still figuring this one out! Motion warping is being strange.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]We plan on continuing to add new stuff to the demo. See details below![/h1][p][/p][h2]Plans for future major updates in the Demo:[/h2][p]One of the consistent things we've heard from players about the demo is that combat was too easy! This was partially intentional, as we didn't want combat to keep any players from completing the story. However, it left many players wanting more. [b]We want to use the demo as a testing ground to make sure our battle system is refined enough to make the full game a ton of fun.[/b][/p][p]So, we have a future update planned that will add some new battles into the Quick Battle Mode! We want to show a more refined version of the battle combat we have in mind, with enough depth to it to match what we want in the full game. [b]Our goal is to make these battles will be more "realistic" to the final product, and should represent an average, mid-game battle an experienced player might face.[/b][/p][p]We'll also use them as a test bed for gameplay iteration! We have plenty of ideas for new abilities, enemies, etc. We also have heard plenty of feedback about UI design and control usability, especially in regards to moving those dinosaurs around complex terrain. We're going to give these issues plenty of attention as well.[/p][p][b]In the future, expect more enemy types, better, more competent AI, and a higher difficulty for players more used to tactical games.[/b] These battles will be entirely standalone and separate from the story demo; They might have a few lines of dialogue, but won't have any major story components.[/p][p]When we have more details, we'll announce them here. [/p][p][/p][h2]Other, smaller planned demo updates for the future:[/h2][list][*][p]Dialogue noises![/p][/*][*][p]Refined sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Rework of the Radio, Ventriloquism and Social Call mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]UI Rework! The main menu and pause menu need visual improvements, and the battle UI can be much improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Controls enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Explore mode dialogue: characters will have small comments and conversations when you walk near them in the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Model improvements: animations, blinking, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]More fixes and improvements! Still a few stray crashes and bugs, as well as our known issues.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]What's next apart than the other stuff?[/h2][list][*][p]To be announced! We're working on some very exciting things we can't talk about yet![/p][/*][*][p]Character profile social media posts! Official confirmation of each dino's species (you would not believe how many people have been asking for that, my gosh. We see you, dino nerds!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Are you a publisher that wants to collaborate with us?[/b] Send us an email at contact@ossifrage.games! We've been approached by a few already, but talks are still ongoing!  [/p][/*][/list][p]To close us out this time have a screenshot: This VN event featuring a very sad Daisy was prevented from playing by a bug (which has now been fixed.) See if you can find it in the new build! Thanks for following! Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893154/253ec70df6d9e2d610fb7f2e60a039e01acde881.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Clever Girls Demo Release 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Dinosaurs are on the scene![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893154/859edbc078ac8b96d0c95759c59f81663e83f45a.png"][/img][/p][h2]After two [i]years [/i]in the making, the Clever Girls Demo is released!
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162300/Clever_Girls_Demo/" style="button"]Play the Demo now![/url][/h2][p]
The demo features a short unique storyline, and a small preview of [i]some[/i] of the mechanics the full game will have. Learn the basics of dinosaur combat tactics! Watch dinosaurs discover the power of theater! Dig through some interesting garbage![/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback Welcome![/h2][p]Please play the demo and let us know what you think! Leave a review! We want all your feedback so we know what to add to the demo, and what to change for the full game.[/p][p]Leave a steam review, make a post on the community hub, or use the in-game links to the feedback form. We want to hear from you! (Especially if you had fun!)[/p][p][/p][h2]Known Issues for 1.0.2, and Upcoming Updates[/h2][p]The build is fairly well-tested, and should be playable for most users. However, there's some things we plan on updating in the near future. Here's a list of known issues we'll fix and changes we plan on making soon.[/p][list][*][p][b]Crash upon second phase of level 2[/b] [b]\[FIXED in 1.0.3, out now] [/b]A certain enemy in the second half of level 2 would crash the game upon taking his turn. This enemy has been removed pending further investigation. If this issue occurs to you, please update your game and try again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Savegames created during certain points in the story may result in various cosmetic issues or crashes upon loading.[/b] We're working on fixing these. In the meantime, if you encounter such a save, please reload to an earlier autosave instead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some players are experiencing GPU crashes upon startup.[/b] This is a difficult one to for us to address, so bear with us if this is happening to you. We recommend ensuring your graphics card drivers are up to date. We're looking into what we can do to address these.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Characters in battle combat can sometimes get stuck.[/b] If this occurs, please press the "undo movement" input. If that fails, make a manual save, and then reload it. If you find your character appears to be "caught" on something while moving, wiggle them left and right slightly while pressing forward. We're working on making character movement across the battle grid more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some VN scenes seem to be missing character art.[/b] We're working on adding VN characters to a few scenes which slipped our notice.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemies sometimes waste their turns instead of attacking.[/b] While enemies in the "Panic" status are expected to sometimes prioritize running away instead of attacking, we want to make the regular enemy AI more effective at searching for and fighting dinos. This will take time! The poacher AI is one of the more complex elements of the project.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter an issue, please use the in-game link to the bug report form. Here's a [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScuPSP55xx4unqtE5os_kV8HxHsAuroA9tlHHXus57Tykcf4A/viewform?usp=dialog"]link to the report form[/url] here, too!
[/p][h2]What's next?[/h2][p]It depends on what we hear back from you all! We'll work on the above improvements to the demo. As we make improvements, we'll announce them here. We're going to gather all the data we can from the demo and put it to use working on the full game.

In the future, once we are further in development, we'd like to update the demo to include the introductory parts of the full game, with transferable saves, to let people get a preview of the full title. When we're ready to announce that officially, we'll do so here![/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: [b]Crash upon second phase of level 2[/b] [b]  [FIXED in 1.0.3, out now] [/b]A certain enemy in the second half of level 2 would crash the game upon taking his turn. This enemy has been removed pending further investigation. If this issue occurs to you, please update your game and try again.

[b]Savegames created during certain points in the story may result in various cosmetic issues or crashes upon loading.[/b] We're working on fixing these. In the meantime, if you encounter such a save, please reload to an earlier autosave instead.

[b]Some players are experiencing GPU crashes upon startup.[/b] This is a difficult one to for us to address, so bear with us if this is happening to you. We recommend ensuring your graphics card drivers are up to date. We're looking into what we can do to address these.

[b]Characters in battle combat can sometimes get stuck.[/b] If this occurs, please press the "undo movement" input. If that fails, make a manual save, and then reload it. If you find your character appears to be "caught" on something while moving, wiggle them left and right slightly while pressing forward. We're working on making character movement across the battle grid more fluid.
[b]Some VN scenes seem to be missing character art.[/b] We're working on adding VN characters to a few scenes which slipped our notice.

tags.balance_change: [b]Enemies sometimes waste their turns instead of attacking.[/b] While enemies in the "Panic" status are expected to sometimes prioritize running away instead of attacking, we want to make the regular enemy AI more effective at searching for and fighting dinos. This will take time! The poacher AI is one of the more complex elements of the project.

notes.title: Clever Girls Demo announcement: "Dress Rehearsal," Fall 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893154/859edbc078ac8b96d0c95759c59f81663e83f45a.png[/img]

Hey all! We're super excited to announce an upcoming playable demo for Clever Girls! 

We're calling it "Dress Rehearsal". [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162300/Clever_Girls_Demo/]Check out the demo's own steam page![/url]

Clever Girls is a big project with a lot yet to be done! But, we wanted to get something playable to you all as soon as possible. We're making this demo as a small "rehearsal" that demonstrates what the full game will be like, with some key differences, and some work-in-progress features. Here's a breakdown:

[h2]In the "Dress Rehearsal" Demo, Fall 2024:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bite-sized, non-canon, linear slice-of-life visual novel story. Get to know our main characters in a relaxed setting as they explore an abandoned campsite and perform some dramatic reenactments!
[*] 4 playable characters with unique combat abilities
[*] An early look at a simplified turn-based stealth-battle system, with 3 battles including a tutorial. Special character abilities, too!
[*] A mid-sized map to explore with ambience that changes as the demo story progresses, and plenty of interactions.
[/list]

[h2]Features [b]NOT[/b] in "Dress Rehearsal" that we want to have in the full game:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Branching storylines, and an in-depth relationship system spanning across friendships, romances and rivalries between all four characters
[*] Full-fledged RPG progression system and new character ability unlocks
[*] Many more zones and environmental interactions
[*] Much, much more!
[/list]

It's shaping up really well and we'll release it as soon as we feel it's ready! We've been working on it for a while and are targeting the remaining months of fall this year to send it out.

Check out the steam page for even more details. If you have the main game wishlisted, you'll receive an email when the demo launches.

Thanks for reading! As a special bonus, we'll leave you with some development art, a look at some studies of Sawyer, a utahraptor and an aspiring (if overzealous!) pack leader:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893154/4f0a779f2c14ae24b1d16ea4d72c8b2a3ed6c2ef.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more info (and a demo release date!) We'll send it as soon as we have it!
